notes.title: Playtest build 625
notes.content:
Updates:
- 3d board now scales for higher resolution displays
- certain buttons on the main menu previously could cause
the game to hang. This is no longer the case.
- Game recording added. Games are recorded in standard pgn format,
which can be analyzed with external tools. All your games are recorded (local, ai, and online).

notes.title: Playtest build 610: Performance
notes.content:
- Improve fullscreen performance on windows when in the background. Previously this could result in freezing.
- Improved formatting of times < 10 seconds.
